one_liner_zh: Intuit 上季 EPS 4.15 美元大超預期12.7%、營收 46.5 億美元，平台動能與成本控管俱佳。
one_liner_en: Intuit beat EPS at $4.15 by 12.7% on $4.65B revenue, with strong platform momentum and cost discipline.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 超預期 12.69%，獲利顯著優於估計（營收年增率未提供）。
ai_view_zh: 訊號正向：EPS 大幅超預期顯示成本控管與平台變現俱佳。短期財報利多有助情緒。中期關鍵在報稅季（旺季）能否兌現全年指引，以及 AI 助手對 ARPU 與留存的實質貢獻。本益比約17倍給予估值彈性。追蹤線上生態系成長、QuickBooks 訂閱數與 Credit Karma 變現。
ai_view_en: Signal is positive: the large EPS beat reflects cost discipline and platform monetization. Near term the beat aids sentiment. Mid term, the key is whether the peak tax season delivers on full-year guidance and whether the AI assistant meaningfully lifts ARPU and retention. A ~17x P/E offers valuation flexibility. Track Online Ecosystem growth, QuickBooks subscriptions and Credit Karma monetization.
highlights_zh: EPS 4.15 美元，超預期 12.69%，獲利表現亮眼
營收 46.5 億美元，平台動能穩健
Credit Karma 與 QuickBooks 線上業務成長
AI 功能持續強化用戶價值與留存
highlights_en: EPS of $4.15 beat by 12.69%, a strong profitability beat
Revenue of $4.65B with steady platform momentum
Growth in Credit Karma and QuickBooks online
AI features keep enhancing user value and retention
risks_zh: 本期未提供營收年增率，成長能見度有限
報稅季前的非旺季營收基數較低
中小企業景氣與消費信貸環境波動
risks_en: Revenue YoY not provided, limiting growth visibility
Lower revenue base in the pre-peak quarter
SMB conditions and consumer credit environment volatility
